title: Amendment Charges and Change Deadlines by Vacation Package Product
content:
Each of the Vacation Package Products publishes its own charges for changing a booked package. The schedule fixes whether the departure date may be moved after booking at all, the charge per traveller to move it, the maximum number of date changes permitted on one package, the charge per traveller to replace one member of the party, the calendar days before departure by which such a replacement must be made, and the administration charge per traveller applied to any other amendment.

| Product | Date change | Date change per traveller | Date changes permitted | Name change per traveller | Name change deadline | Amendment administration per traveller |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | not permitted | 0.00 USD | 0 | 95.00 USD | 14 calendar days | 45.00 USD |
| Flex Bundle Package | permitted | 95.00 USD | 2 | 75.00 USD | 10 calendar days | 35.00 USD |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | permitted | 125.00 USD | 2 | 85.00 USD | 14 calendar days | 40.00 USD |
| Escorted Tour Package | permitted | 150.00 USD | 1 | 125.00 USD | 21 calendar days | 50.00 USD |
| Ocean Cruise Package | not permitted | 0.00 USD | 0 | 175.00 USD | 35 calendar days | 65.00 USD |
| Luxury Collection Package | permitted | 0.00 USD | 4 | 0.00 USD | 7 calendar days | 0.00 USD |

## Notes on the columns

The date-change column and the count of permitted date changes stand together: the Value Bundle Package and the Ocean Cruise Package permit no move of the departure date and publish a count of 0 and a charge of nil accordingly. Among the products that do permit a move, the count runs from 1 on the Escorted Tour Package to 4 on the Luxury Collection Package.

The name-change deadline is a distance in calendar days before departure and is not ranked with the charge: the Ocean Cruise Package carries both the longest deadline, 35 calendar days, and the highest charge, 175.00 USD, while the Luxury Collection Package carries the shortest deadline, 7 calendar days, and no charge at all.

The amendment administration charge is the figure the product publishes for an amendment other than a date change or a replacement of a party member. It falls to nil on the Luxury Collection Package and stands highest at 65.00 USD on the Ocean Cruise Package.
